pages.text: $(l)Side quest progression$()$(li)Early parts of the side quests (top and bottom) are doable pre-Cannon; the ends require Cosmic Balance (except Sprens for Freedom Steel).

$(l)Tricky recipes$()$(li)The Better Sane Thoughts recipe is locked behind the Bedrock Blaster and requires passivating the Infinity Pick in the duplication recipe.$(li)The cauldron recipe is the only one that becomes meaningfully more annoying to craft at higher tiers.
